replacements.instruction: 5.2 に統合した robustness qualification の内容は変えず、既存の Appendix 参照ルールに合わせて 'See Appendix ... for ...' 形式にする。
replacements.before: Resource-matched sensitivity analyses in Appendix~\ref{app:sensitivity-analyses} largely preserve the pairwise direction, whereas cross-family rescoring is less stable and reverses the WritingBench direction against \condSinglePass.
replacements.after: See Appendix~\ref{app:sensitivity-analyses} for sensitivity analyses: resource-matched comparisons largely preserve the pairwise direction, whereas cross-family rescoring is less stable and reverses the WritingBench direction against \condSinglePass.
